metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2006 · Jane Eyre
metas.description: A young governess falls in love with her brooding and complex master. However, his dark past may destroy their relationship forever.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2000 · Queer as Folk
metas.description: Brash humor and genuine emotion make up this series revolving around the lives, loves, ambitions, careers and friendships of a group of gay men and women living on Liberty Avenue in contemporary Pittsburgh, PA.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2004 · Doc Martin
metas.description: The trials and tribulations of Martin Ellingham, a brilliant but socially challenged doctor who moves from London to the picturesque village of Port Wenn in Cornwall.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2009 · Emma
metas.description: Emma Woodhouse, a wealthy young woman living in the early 19th century, whose misplaced confidence in her matchmaking abilities occasions several romantic misadventures, which leads her into deeper meanings of love and life

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2008 · Forbidden Love
metas.description: A rich man named Adnan marries Bihter, who is younger than him. A poisonous forbidden love begins between Adnan's nephew Behlül and Bihter who lives in the same mansion.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2009 · Boys Over Flowers
metas.description: Geum Jan Di gets a scholarship to the elite Shin Hwa High School. She is picked on by Gu Jun Pyo, one of the richest and most popular students, but soon Jun Pyo finds himself attracted to her.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2001 · Degrassi: The Next Generation
metas.description: The lives of the kids at Degrassi Community School deal with the serious and sometimes taboo issues that plague teenagers.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2007 · Asi
metas.description: The Kozcuoglu family, who have lived on their farm in Hatay for generations, faces challenges when Demir, a successful businessman, moves to the city. Demir has a purpose for revenge regarding his mother's suicide in the Asi River.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2008 · Sense & Sensibility
metas.description: In 1800s England, sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood try to find love and security. The two could not be more different: Eleanor is calm and decorous; Marianne is passionate and heedless.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2006 · Ouran High School Host Club
metas.description: You'll fall for the Ouran Host Club: Tamaki's truly romantic. Kaoru and Hikaru display brotherly love, Kyoya's brainy, Honey's innocent, and Mori's manly. Oh, and don't forget Haruhi. He knows what girls want, because he's a girl ...

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2008 · Little Dorrit
metas.description: The Dorrits are a family whose life revolves around the Marshalsea, a debtor's prison. Amy Dorrit's kind nature brings the family into contact with a wide swath of English society, from the poorest to the richest, and back again.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2009 · Wuthering Heights
metas.description: Foundling Heathcliff is raised by the wealthy Earnshaws in Yorkshire but in later life launches a vendetta against the family.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2005 · Fingersmith
metas.description: In Victorian England, young thief Sue participates in a scam to defraud a rich heiress by becoming her maid. Things take an unexpected turn and Sue's plan goes horribly wrong.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2007 · Journeyman
metas.description: A San Francisco journalist mysteriously travels to the past and alters the path of people's lives. When his travels reunite him with his long-lost fiancée Livia, life with his present-day wife gets very interesting.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2008 · Lark Rise to Candleford
metas.description: An adaptation of Flora Thompson's autobiographical novel "Lark Rise To Candleford", set in 19th-century Oxfordshire, in which a young girl moves to the local market town to begin an apprenticeship as a postmistress.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2005 · The War at Home
metas.description: Parents struggle to raise their teens.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2002 · Still Standing
metas.description: Bill and Judy are not your average parents; the kids are the responsible ones.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2007 · Army Wives
metas.description: Four women and one man share the common bond of loving someone in the U.S. Army.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2007 · The 1st Shop of Coffee Prince
metas.description: A tomboy, mistaken for a lad, maintains the deception for the sake of employment. The situation becomes complicated when her male boss begins to develop feelings for this "boy."

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2005 · Into the West
metas.description: Tales from the American West in the 19th century, told from the perspective of two families, one of white settlers and one of Native Americans.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2002 · The Forsyte Saga
metas.description: Chronicles the lives of three generations of the upper-middle-class British family, the Forsytes, from the 1870s to 1920.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2008 · Tess of the D'Urbervilles
metas.description: The story of Tess Durbeyfield, a low-born country girl whose family find they have noble connections.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2003 · No One Could Live Here
metas.description: Follows the inhabitants of a fictional building in Spain.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2000 · Girlfriends
metas.description: A look at the lives, loves, and losses of four different women: Toni, Maya, Lynn, and Joan.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2005 · South of Nowhere
metas.description: A family moves from Ohio to Los Angeles, where they realize they are unprepared for the city's fast pace and the overcrowded public school that the three teenagers will attend.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2005 · Kitchen Confidential
metas.description: A bad-boy chef runs wild in his New York City eatery.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2007 · The Company
metas.description: Real-life figures from the Cold War-era mix with a fictional story based on a group of C.I.A. operatives and their counterparts in the K.G.B., MI6, and the Mossad.
